title: The instructor's last class
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The last class of the term. The instructor gives the auditor the last word, which she has never done. He says nothing for the length of a panel. She says that's a thesis too. Class dismissed.

panels.composition: The classroom, last day. The INSTRUCTOR at the board, the board wiped. Adults gathering books. WOOD at the back.

image.prompt: a classroom at the end of term with a wiped chalkboard, adult students gathering their things, a young man at the back, black and white, no words

balloons.text: Mr. Finch. Last word. You've had none all term.

image.prompt: a woman instructor at the front of a classroom, looking at the back row, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood. The class turned to look. A balloon over him, empty. The panel held.

image.prompt: a young man at the back of a classroom with every face turned toward him, saying nothing, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The instructor, picking up her bag.

image.prompt: a woman instructor picking up her bag at the end of class, satisfied, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The empty balloon, given the last word. 'That's a thesis too.'
